narr: Warm and humid conditions with dewpoints in the low 70s fueled an early evening cluster of thunderstorms southwest of Indianapolis. A moist profile promoted efficient rainfall production, with resultant bands of torrential downpours training from northeast of Gosport into far west-central Morgan County.
ev: A trained spotter 4 miles northwest of Paragon reported over 5 inches of rain in less than 4 hours, resulting in water 8 inches deep flowing across Leitzman Road.
lsr: 8 inches of flowing water across Leitzman Road. Rain gauge measured over 5 of rain.
